operator-004.*: semantic-note: integer / integer is emitted unchanged, so the result type is backend semantics (plan 3.3): integer division on PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite, exact NUMBER division on Oracle, DOUBLE on Databricks.

operator-012.SqlServer: semantic-note: || becomes +, so NULL propagation follows CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL (ON in every supported configuration).

order-page-001.*: semantic-note: the default null ordering is backend semantics (plan 3.3); the emitter injects no NULLS FIRST/LAST.

order-page-005.SqlServer: semantic-note: ASC NULLS FIRST is the native T-SQL ordering, so the clause is omitted.

order-page-008.SqlServer: semantic-note: DESC NULLS LAST is the native T-SQL ordering, so the clause is omitted.

select-024.Oracle: semantic-note: LIKE is case-sensitive (the session NLS_COMP/NLS_SORT is pinned by the gateway).
select-024.SqlServer: semantic-note: LIKE follows the column collation (usually case-insensitive).

literal-013.Oracle: semantic-note: the empty string is NULL in Oracle, so the bound '' is NULL (SEC-ADG-17).

complex-018.Oracle: semantic-note: NULLIF(a, '') compares with NULL on Oracle because '' is NULL (SEC-ADG-17).

literal-021.SqlServer: semantic-note: the boolean literal is emitted as the integer 1 (no boolean type).
literal-021.Sqlite: semantic-note: the boolean literal is emitted as the integer 1 (no boolean type).
literal-021.Oracle: semantic-note: the boolean literal is emitted as the integer 1 (no SQL boolean in SELECT lists).

fn-string-009.Oracle: semantic-note: the three-argument CONCAT is emitted as nested two-argument CONCAT calls; Oracle treats NULL as the empty string (Trino returns NULL).

fn-string-010.SqlServer: semantic-note: SUBSTR is emitted as SUBSTRING and the missing length as 2147483647; a start below 1 is backend semantics (Trino counts a negative start from the end).

fn-string-011.SqlServer: semantic-note: SUBSTR is emitted as SUBSTRING and the missing length as 2147483647; a start below 1 is backend semantics (Trino counts a negative start from the end).

fn-string-012.SqlServer: semantic-note: the two-argument SUBSTRING gets the missing length as 2147483647; a start below 1 is backend semantics (Trino counts a negative start from the end).
fn-string-012.Oracle: semantic-note: SUBSTRING is emitted as SUBSTR; a start of 0 is treated as 1 (Trino returns the empty string).

fn-string-017.PostgreSql: semantic-note: the two-argument REPLACE is emitted with an empty bound string as the replacement.
fn-string-017.SqlServer: semantic-note: the two-argument REPLACE is emitted with an empty bound string as the replacement.

fn-string-018.SqlServer: semantic-note: rejected (SqlCompileNotSupportedException); T-SQL has no LPAD and no exact equivalent exists (truncation and a repeated pad string).

fn-string-019.SqlServer: semantic-note: rejected (SqlCompileNotSupportedException); T-SQL has no RPAD and no exact equivalent exists (truncation and a repeated pad string).

fn-string-051.SqlServer: semantic-note: rejected (SqlCompileNotSupportedException); DATALENGTH counts UTF-16 bytes of nvarchar, Trino counts UTF-8 bytes.
fn-string-051.Oracle: semantic-note: OCTET_LENGTH is emitted as LENGTHB (bytes of the database character set, UTF-8 on AL32UTF8).

fn-string-052.Oracle: semantic-note: CHAR_LENGTH is emitted as LENGTH (characters).

fn-string-053.Oracle: semantic-note: CHARACTER_LENGTH is emitted as LENGTH (characters).

fn-math-013.Oracle: semantic-note: LOG10(x) is emitted as LOG(10, x); a non-positive argument raises ORA-01428 where Trino returns NaN or -Infinity.

setop-010.*: semantic-note: a parenthesized query primary is rejected with AstBuildException (KD-1); the AST has no node that keeps the ORDER BY and LIMIT of a parenthesized query.
